title: STRANGE MINUTE · WHAT IF #4
endSub: Next: what if you fell into Jupiter?

lines.text: What if the Sun switched off right now?
For eight minutes, you wouldn't notice a thing.
Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to reach us.
lines.say: Sunlight takes about eight minutes to reach us.

lines.text: So the light already on its way keeps shining.
Even gravity travels at the speed of light.
So Earth keeps circling an empty spot. Then…
Total darkness. In the middle of the day.
The Moon goes dark too. It only reflects sunlight.
The daytime sky? Suddenly full of stars.
Even the planets fade away, one by one.
The air cools fast. Eclipses drop it about 10 degrees.
lines.say: The air cools fast. Eclipses drop it about ten degrees.

lines.text: Plants stop making food. Birds go quiet.
Then the light returns. Just like that.
But here's the strange part. The Sun you see is 8 minutes old.
lines.say: But here's the strange part. The Sun you see is eight minutes old.

lines.text: Every sunrise you've seen had already happened.
So is the Sun still there right now?

lines.say: You won't know for eight minutes.
